name: Exact Coefficient-Row Reduction
statement: The iterative shared-row reduction projects $\mathcal A(C)$ exactly onto the terminal relation $E_K$: prescribed terminal coefficients extend if and only if they satisfy its surviving local systems. Rational terminal data with rational local witnesses reconstruct rational full coefficients and a positive rational margin certificate.
proof: Rows unique to one local system can be added independently, while positive-front deletion preserves feasibility for fixed coefficients. Alternating these exact steps reaches a greatest fixed point, and reversing them reconstructs every eliminated row and witness.
